newsitem.title: USA: TCI comfortable with cash-flow estimates.
newsitem.headline: TCI comfortable with cash-flow estimates.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc is "comfortable" with analysts' estimates that put operating cash flow in the third quarter at $575 million to $630 million, a company spokeswoman said Thursday.

The spokeswoman said TCI, the nation's largest cable company, experienced some decline in customer numbers in July and August. There was also some growth in its customer base in the first week of September, she added.
She attributed the decline in customers, which she did not quantify, to recent rate increases and to the usual summer lull in the entertainment business.
